{{Top|leg}}
'''Stun filaments''' lined the interior of [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stuncuffs]], and were capable of delivering paralyzing energy jolts to the wearer. Triggered by a remote control unit, the stun filaments could be set to a variety of intensity levels. Lower-power settings would cause the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] pain, while a high-power setting could render the prisoner unconscious.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
